newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Works Corp NZ reports NZ$16 mln annual profit.
newsitem.headline: Works Corp NZ reports NZ$16 mln annual profit.

text.p: Works and Development Services Corp (NZ) Ltd (WORKS) said on Thursday its annual profit for the 1995/96 year was NZ$16 million, a return on shareholders' funds of 16 percent.

The annual report is the corporation's last, as the two subsidiary companies which make up WORKS -- Works Civil Construction Ltd and Works Consultancy Services Ltd, were recently sold for NZ$44 million and $45.8 million respectively.
WORKS said after tax profit was up 32 percent on the 1994/95 profit of $12.2 million.
